name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent
description: Dev-time type-only shim for the dsh-advisor plugin repo. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub provides the consumed type surface (the Agent handle, the ctx.agents augmentation, and the agent/created + agent/disposed cordis events). Mirrors dsh-private commit b8343cb (2026-08-09 snapshot).
